note: A worked example of the input the package takes. Three invented questions, six distinct premises in each pool. introspected is what a forecaster stated in advance would decide the question; extracted is what forecasts of the question were later found to disagree on. In drug-approval-by-june the first extracted premise appears twice more, once exactly and once with a double space, as it would when several pairs of forecasts disagree on the same thing; both commands report these two repeats as removed before selection. Nothing here comes from a study.

introspected: Will the tunnel boring be finished before the winter shutdown?
Will the regulator issue the safety certificate without further conditions?
Will the signalling system pass its integration test on the first attempt?
Will the operator have enough certified drivers by the opening date?
Will the final cost exceed the revised budget by more than ten percent?
Will a legal challenge from the neighbouring district delay the opening?
extracted: Does the tunnel carry fare paying passengers at any point during 2027?
Is the remaining excavation complete before the winter weather stops work?
Does the safety regulator attach extra conditions to the certificate?
Have the published accounts shown an overrun above ten percent?
Is the contractor the same one that delivered the previous line late?
Do the unions call industrial action during the commissioning period?

introspected: Will the phase three trial meet its primary endpoint?
Will the agency convene an advisory committee before deciding?
Will the manufacturing site pass its pre-approval inspection?
Will the safety signal seen in the earlier trial recur at scale?
Will the agency's review clock be extended by a major amendment?
Will a competing product reach the market first?
extracted: Did the trial hit its primary endpoint at the pre-specified significance?
Is an advisory committee meeting scheduled before the decision date?
Was the manufacturing site cleared at inspection?
Did the trial hit its primary endpoint at the pre-specified significance?
How common was the liver enzyme elevation in the larger population?
Is the sponsor's regulatory track record good enough to avoid delay?
Did the trial hit its primary  endpoint at the pre-specified significance?
Does the agency treat this as a priority review?

introspected: Will the weather on polling day be unusually bad?
Will postal voting be expanded before the election?
Will the two main parties be within three points in the final polls?
Will the new identification requirement reduce turnout among young voters?
Will turnout in the last comparable election be beaten?
Will a major national event fall in the same week?
extracted: Does the closeness of the race drive people to the polls?
How many postal ballots are issued compared with the previous cycle?
Does the identification rule suppress turnout in the youngest age band?
Is polling day a working day or a holiday?
Did the previous election of this type clear sixty percent?
Are the campaigns spending on turnout operations or on persuasion?
